verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is a Windows support article about backing up a BitLocker recovery key. That implies Windows ships its own disk encryption (BitLocker), but the pack never says it is TPM-backed or describes how to enable it. Missing for 10: any documentation that encryption is bound to or unlocked by the TPM, steps for enabling and configuring disk encryption, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can encrypt my disk using TPM-backed hardware encryption

citations.quote: Back up your BitLocker recovery key
